issue.body:
I may misunderstand how the `Mount` works. But this is a short snippet:

```python
app = Starlette(
    routes=[
        Mount(
            '/graphql',
            GraphQL(schema.schema, debug=DEBUG_MODE))
        ),
    ],
    on_startup([database.connect]),
    on_shutdown([database.disconnect]),
)
```

However, in the ariadne graphql resolver when i tried to use `database` i got errors complaining `Database Backend is not running` (if i do another `await database.connect()` there then it works, so this suggests that the `database.connect()` was not awaited on starlette startup?

The `database` here is also from encode: https://www.encode.io/databases/ 

The application is started by `uvicorn main:app`

Edit: Now I tried this:

```python
async def test_connect():
    raise Exception("Hello")


app = Starlette(
    routes=[
        Mount(
            '/graphql',
            GraphQL(schema.schema, debug=DEBUG_MODE))
        ),
    ],
    on_startup([test_connect]),
    on_shutdown([database.disconnect]),
)
```

Starting the application and I don't see the exception raised. The application is also running just fine (shouldn't it be stopped?)

Version: starlette 0.13.4
issue.title: on_startup async functions are not awaited
